lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Left tab to saddle-wall fold, about 77 deg with a small radius (Ri about 2 mm), clearly separate from the large U roll. My perpendicular sections at 10/25/50/75/90% put the line 0.02-0.07 mm from the outer-skin point whose normal is along the outward bisector. The outer skin is the convex side: tab underside running into the U inner face. The line is parallel to both planes (dv.n = 0.000). It runs 39.1 mm across a fold-zone extent of -0.6 to 39.9 mm, i.e. edge to edge of the 40 mm wide part.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Right tab to saddle-wall fold, about 77 deg with a small radius, the mirror of B1. Sections at 10/25/50/75/90% put the line 0.01-0.27 mm from the outer apex point, well under 1 mm. The line is parallel (dv.n = 0.000) and spans 39.2 mm of the roughly 40.5 mm fold zone.
